data.content_ref: inline:The mechanism is asserted as a causal 'Low-Pass Filter' but never specifies the physical process by which a checklist 'excises high-frequency signal.' To filter signal there must be a transformation that maps nuanced inputs to degraded outputs; SRC_001 instead restates the conclusion (ceiling on reliability) as a metaphor. It also provides no within-evaluation test that would distinguish a genuine reliability ceiling from a checklist that is simply not yet well-designed, so the causal story is unfalsifiable in a single evaluation.
